The pair Vgs (≈0.73 V) plus the tail Vdsat leave only ~0.05 V of headroom at vcm = 0.9 V. That pushes the tail into the edge of saturation and drives M2 into triode, which turns off M5 and M6. Raising the pair gm/Id lowers its Vgs and restores tail headroom. The existing stage topology and polarity are otherwise consistent, so I'm making one targeted edit.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Tail headroom (vcm - Vgs_pair - Vdsat_tail) is ~0.05 V, so the tail goes to the edge of saturation and M2 goes triode. This starves out1, turning off M5 and M6. Raising the pair gm/Id lowers Vgs_pair and restores headroom. Stage topology and polarity are otherwise unchanged."}
```

```python
VDD = 1.8
GMID_REF, L_REF = 18.0, 0.5   # reference diode for all NMOS mirrors

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":  (21.0, 18.0, 22.0),       # NMOS pair gm/Id (high gm/Id -> lower Vgs -> tail headroom)
    "L_in":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # NMOS pair length
    "gmid_ld":  (10.0, 6.0, 12.0),        # PMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "L_ld":     (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),          # PMOS mirror load length
    "I_tail":   (2.5e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),     # stage-1 tail current
    "I_s2":     (3.0e-6, 2e-6, 4.5e-6),   # stage-2 CS / pb-generator current
    "gmid_s2":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),        # stage-2 CS gm/Id
    "L_s2":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),         # stage-2 length
    "I_inv":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 200e-6),  # output inverter peak drive (dynamic only)
    "L_inv":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),        # inverter length
    "gmid_inv": (10.0, 5.0, 12.0),        # inverter gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec["cl"]
    vod = spec["vod"]
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)

    # bias mirrors (same gm/Id and L as reference diode)
    m0   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt   = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_tail"], vds=0.6)
    mpbn = lut.size("n", GMID_REF, L_REF, p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)

    # pb generator: PMOS diode M7 sourcing I_s2 (sunk by Mpbn); M6 mirrors pb
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.6)

    # stage 1: NMOS pair + PMOS mirror load (M3 diode on d1, M4 mirrors to out1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.9)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.5)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], p["I_tail"] / 2, vds=0.5)

    # stage 2: NMOS CS (gate out1) with PMOS current source (gate pb)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_s2"], p["L_s2"], p["I_s2"], vds=0.5)

    # output CMOS inverter (dynamic only; static-free at rails)
    mon = lut.size("n", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)
    mop = lut.size("p", p["gmid_inv"], p["L_inv"], p["I_inv"], vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias network
    n.dev("M0",   "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m0)
    n.dev("Mt",   "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mpbn", "pb",    "ibias", "vss", "vss", mpbn)
    n.dev("M7",   "pb",    "pb",    "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    # stage 1: 5T OTA with PMOS mirror load
    n.dev("M1", "d1",   "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)     # vinp drives the diode-side branch
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m2)     # vinn drives the output-side branch
    n.dev("M3", "d1",   "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", m3)     # mirror diode
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1",   "vdd",  "vdd", m4)     # mirror output
    # stage 2 (inverting)
    n.dev("M5", "out2", "out1", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M6", "out2", "pb",   "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    # output inverter (inverting)
    n.dev("MPo", "vout", "out2", "vdd", "vdd", mop)
    n.dev("MNo", "vout", "out2", "vss", "vss", mon)

    # first-order predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    G1 = m2.gds + m4.gds
    A1 = gm1 / G1
    gm5 = m5.gm
    A2 = gm5 / (m5.gds + m6.gds)
    Ainv = (mon.gm + mop.gm) / (mon.gds + mop.gds)

    C1 = m5.cgg + m2.cdd + m4.cdd
    C2 = mon.cgg + mop.cgg + m5.cdd + m6.cdd
    tau1 = C1 / gm1
    tau2 = C2 / gm5

    gain_tot = max(A1 * A2 * max(Ainv, 1.0), 1.0)
    t_lin = (tau1 + tau2) * math.log(max((VDD / 2) / (gain_tot * vod), 1.0))
    t_slew = cl * (VDD / 2) / p["I_inv"]
    tpd = t_lin + t_slew

    # supply: reference + tail (Mt) + pb generator (M7) + M6
    power = VDD * (iref + p["I_tail"] + 2.0 * p["I_s2"])

    # tail headroom (positive = ok)
    tail_headroom = vcm - m1.vgs - mt.vdsat

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "polarity_ok": 1.0,
        "tail_headroom": tail_headroom,
        "A1": A1, "A2": A2, "Ainv": Ainv,
    }
```
